name: grove
description: Connect Codex to a Grove firm. Read returns, fact sheets, document checklists; import Drake and Lacerte backups end-to-end.

interface.shortDescription: Your firm's tax returns, from your editor
interface.longDescription: Grove connects Codex to your firm in Grove. Once installed, ask Codex to list authorized returns, summarize a client's fact sheet, generate a 'still missing these documents' email, or import a Drake / Lacerte backup from your machine. All requests run against your firm via OAuth — no API keys to paste.
defaultPrompt: List my open returns in Grove.
What documents is my client still missing?
Import a Drake or Lacerte backup into Grove.
Draft a 'still missing documents' email for a client.
